explanations: redact() recurses into plain objects and masks strings, but an array is not a plain object (its prototype is Array.prototype), so it falls through to `return value` and is logged untouched. The reminder job logs `failed: [{ appointmentId, patient }]`, so every patient in that list is written out in full. Bare strings inside arrays also skip the email masking. Booking logs pass because the patient there is a nested object, not an array element. The fix maps over arrays and redacts each element, which also builds a new array so the logged object isn't modified.
